scope: Synthetic DOM and local preference regression only. Authentication provider activation and real sign-in require separate verification.

groups.name: Local entry collects no credentials or pretends to authenticate with Google/Apple
Personal info contains no fabricated customer, encrypted-record or subscription status
Opening preferences performs no writes and never invents a saved nickname
Save, reload and edit preserve unknown preference fields and unrelated/legacy health bytes
Restore is an explicit local read and leaves all saved bytes unchanged
Failed preference write retains draft, saved bytes and visible retry feedback
Malformed or unsupported preferences are never repaired/overwritten by opening or saving
Stale or deleted preferences are not resurrected from an open editor
Nickname validation rejects long/control text, permits literal markup as harmless input, and clears to default
Onboarding blocked write prevents progress and preserves saved answers plus visible draft feedback
Onboarding completion does not navigate or claim completion after a failed write; retry succeeds
Onboarding corrupt, denied or stale records remain unchanged instead of being overwritten
